question: Will the 12-month change in the U.S. core PCE price index, excluding food and energy (BEA, seasonally adjusted; computed from the index) for August 2026 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2026-08-14) be above 3.30%?

rule.threshold_basis: a round number near the upper quartile of historical moves over the same distance

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis
